Our story

A studio that began in 1964.

Soulful Story Photography began in 1964, when the late Mr. Chimanlal Parekh founded M/S Parekh Studio (DRS Photo Studio).

That flourishing business is now inherited by his three sons, working ambitiously and capturing their clients' precious moments — the same patience behind the lens, the same belief that a photograph should feel like the moment itself.

1964

Mr. Chimanlal Parekh founds Parekh Studio / DRS Photo Studio.

Today

His three sons carry the craft forward — weddings, films, portraits and products.

How it works

Three easy steps.

01

Tell us about your day

Share the date, the occasion and what matters most to you — on WhatsApp, by email, or through the form below.

02

We plan the shoot together

We talk through the moments you want kept, the people, the place — and shape the day around them.

03

You receive your story

Photographs and films, edited with care, delivered for you to keep, share and print.

Good to know

Questions, answered.

How do we book a shoot?

Share your date and what you are planning on WhatsApp or email. We will confirm availability and plan the shoot with you from there.

What should we share when we enquire?

The date, the occasion, the place, and anything that matters most to you — a person, a ritual, a moment you do not want missed.

Can we see your own previous work?

Yes — the studio's own albums are shared on enquiry. The photographs and films on this sample page are illustrative stock imagery, standing in until the studio's own work is added.

Do you shoot both photographs and video?

Yes. Traditional and cinematic video, candid and traditional photography, live mixing and streaming, and drone — all from the same team, on the same day.
